entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I'm... I'm a bit lost. I ordered a jersey and it's just not right. I tried looking at the website, but it's all so confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. I think I ordered a medium, but it's just way too tight. I wanted to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure out the forms online. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely take care of that for you. Getting you the right size is no problem at all. Do you happen to have your order number?
Yes, I think so. Let me find it... here it is. It's VF-994-0281.
Perfect, thank you. One moment while I pull up your details... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Mesh Jersey, delivered about 50 days ago.
Is that okay? It's been a while, I know. I just didn't know what to do.
That is completely fine. That item falls under our standard 90-day return policy, so you are well within the timeframe for an exchange.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. So you can help me get a different size?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the exchange for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just use that to send back the jersey that's too tight, and we'll ship out the larger size as soon as we get the return tracking.
Wow, that was so easy. Thank you so much, Isaac!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
